column5: {"documentStyle":{},"nodes":[{"style":{},"id":"5wdjy3600","nodes":[{"id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"decorations":[{"fontWeightValue":700,"type":"BOLD"}],"text":"Day 1: Arrival in Guwahati & Transfer to Shillong (2.5hrs/100kms)"},"type":"TEXT"}],"headingData":{"level":6,"textStyle":{"textAlignment":"AUTO"}},"type":"HEADING"},{"paragraphData":{"textStyle":{"textAlignment":"AUTO"}},"style":{},"id":"41myo3789","nodes":[{"id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"decorations":[{"colorData":{"background":"transparent","foreground":"rgb(0, 0, 0)"},"type":"COLOR"}],"text":"Arrive in Guwahati, the gateway to Northeast India. After your arrival, transfer to Shillong, which is about a 3-4 hour drive (approximately 100 km). Check-in to your hotel upon arrival in Shillong, freshen up, and relax. In the evening, explore Police Bazar, a lively market area, and enjoy a stroll around Ward’s Lake. You can also enjoy some local delicacies for dinner."},"type":"TEXT"}],"type":"PARAGRAPH"},{"paragraphData":{"textStyle":{"textAlignment":"AUTO"}},"style":{},"id":"g3j5j3760","nodes":[],"type":"PARAGRAPH"},{"style":{},"id":"fdb623603","nodes":[{"id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"decorations":[{"fontWeightValue":700,"type":"BOLD"}],"text":"Day 2: Shillong Sightseeing"},"type":"TEXT"}],"headingData":{"level":6,"textStyle":{"textAlignment":"AUTO"}},"type":"HEADING"},{"paragraphData":{"textStyle":{"textAlignment":"AUTO"}},"style":{},"id":"ob9n73776","nodes":[{"id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"decorations":[{"colorData":{"background":"transparent","foreground":"rgb(0, 0, 0)"},"type":"COLOR"}],"text":"In the morning, visit Shillong Peak for panoramic views of the city and the surrounding Khasi Hills. Explore Elephant Falls, a beautiful waterfall located on the outskirts of Shillong. Visit the Don Bosco Museum to learn about the culture and traditions of Northeast India. Head to Mawphlang Sacred Forest, a lush green forest with significant cultural importance for the Khasi tribe. Explore Laitlum Canyons for breathtaking views and great photo opportunities. In the evening, enjoy the peaceful atmosphere of Umiam Lake (also called Barapani), a stunning reservoir just outside Shillong."},"type":"TEXT"}],"type":"PARAGRAPH"},{"paragraphData":{"textStyle":{"textAlignment":"AUTO"}},"style":{},"id":"s5dnb3747","nodes":[],"type":"PARAGRAPH"},{"style":{},"id":"gwgl13606","nodes":[{"id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"decorations":[{"fontWeightValue":700,"type":"BOLD"}],"text":"Day 3: Shillong to Cherrapunji (2hrs/60kms)"},"type":"TEXT"}],"headingData":{"level":6,"textStyle":{"textAlignment":"AUTO"}},"type":"HEADING"},{"paragraphData":{"textStyle":{"textAlignment":"AUTO"}},"style":{},"id":"tmgbg3808","nodes":[{"id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"decorations":[{"colorData":{"background":"transparent","foreground":"rgb(0, 0, 0)"},"type":"COLOR"}],"text":"After breakfast, drive to Cherrapunji (approximately 2-3 hours). In the afternoon, visit Nohkalikai Falls, one of the tallest waterfalls in India. Explore Mawsmai Cave, an impressive limestone cave that is well-lit and easy to explore. Visit the Seven Sisters Waterfalls, a series of waterfalls located in the area. Stay overnight in Cherrapunji and enjoy the cool, misty environment of this serene hill station."},"type":"TEXT"}],"type":"PARAGRAPH"},{"paragraphData":{"textStyle":{"textAlignment":"AUTO"}},"style":{},"id":"7p4xp3734","nodes":[],"type":"PARAGRAPH"},{"style":{},"id":"b9ipj3609","nodes":[{"id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"decorations":[{"fontWeightValue":700,"type":"BOLD"}],"text":"Day 4: Cherrapunji Sightseeing"},"type":"TEXT"}],"headingData":{"level":6,"textStyle":{"textAlignment":"AUTO"}},"type":"HEADING"},{"paragraphData":{"textStyle":{"textAlignment":"AUTO"}},"style":{},"id":"51rt83825","nodes":[{"id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"decorations":[{"colorData":{"background":"transparent","foreground":"rgb(0, 0, 0)"},"type":"COLOR"}],"text":"Visit the Living Root Bridges in Nongriat Village, one of the unique natural wonders of Meghalaya. You can take a short trek to reach the famous double-decker root bridge. Explore Dainthlen Waterfall and Thangkharang Park, which offers stunning views of Bangladesh’s plains. Relax and enjoy the evening in the tranquility of Cherrapunji."},"type":"TEXT"}],"type":"PARAGRAPH"},{"headingData":{"level":6,"textStyle":{"textAlignment":"AUTO"}},"id":"ihoqs3617","nodes":[],"type":"HEADING"},{"style":{},"id":"kewme3618","nodes":[{"id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"decorations":[{"fontWeightValue":700,"type":"BOLD"}],"text":"Day 5: Cherrapunji to Mawlynnong & Dawki – Shillong (2hrs/60kms)"},"type":"TEXT"}],"headingData":{"level":6,"textStyle":{"textAlignment":"AUTO"}},"type":"HEADING"},{"paragraphData":{"textStyle":{"textAlignment":"AUTO"}},"style":{},"id":"i54ka3842","nodes":[{"id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"decorations":[{"colorData":{"background":"transparent","foreground":"rgb(0, 0, 0)"},"type":"COLOR"}],"text":"In the morning, drive to Mawlynnong village (2-3 hours), known as the cleanest village in Asia. Enjoy a walk around the village and admire its cleanliness and beautiful surroundings. Visit the Sky View in Mawlynnong, a bamboo structure offering panoramic views of the region and Bangladesh. Continue your journey to Dawki (about 1-1.5 hours), famous for its crystal-clear river Umngot. Enjoy a boat ride in the river, known for its transparent waters. column5: {"documentStyle":{},"nodes":[{"style":{},"id":"egyk65026","nodes":[{"id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"decorations":[{"fontWeightValue":700,"type":"BOLD"}],"text":"Day 1: Arrival in Guwahati & Transfer to Shillong (3-4hrs/100kms)"},"type":"TEXT"}],"headingData":{"level":6,"textStyle":{"textAlignment":"AUTO"}},"type":"HEADING"},{"paragraphData":{"textStyle":{"textAlignment":"AUTO"}},"style":{},"id":"kwib65028","nodes":[{"id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"decorations":[{"colorData":{"background":"transparent","foreground":"rgb(0, 0, 0)"},"type":"COLOR"}],"text":"Arrive in Guwahati via flight or train. From there, transfer to Shillong, the capital of Meghalaya, which takes approximately 3-4 hours by road. Upon arrival in Shillong, check in to your hotel, relax, and freshen up. In the evening, explore Police Bazar, a lively market area, and take a peaceful stroll around Ward’s Lake. Enjoy some local delicacies for dinner and stay overnight at the hotel."},"type":"TEXT"}],"type":"PARAGRAPH"},{"paragraphData":{"textStyle":{"textAlignment":"AUTO"}},"style":{},"id":"pv5qf5190","nodes":[],"type":"PARAGRAPH"},{"style":{},"id":"n5uuu5030","nodes":[{"id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"decorations":[{"fontWeightValue":700,"type":"BOLD"}],"text":"Day 2: Shillong Sightseeing "},"type":"TEXT"}],"headingData":{"level":6,"textStyle":{"textAlignment":"AUTO"}},"type":"HEADING"},{"paragraphData":{"textStyle":{"textAlignment":"AUTO"}},"style":{},"id":"fwrcm5032","nodes":[{"id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"decorations":[{"colorData":{"background":"transparent","foreground":"rgb(0, 0, 0)"},"type":"COLOR"}],"text":"Start your day with a visit to Shillong Peak, where you can enjoy panoramic views of the city and the surrounding Khasi Hills. Next, explore Elephant Falls, one of the most beautiful waterfalls in Shillong. Afterward, head to the Don Bosco Museum to learn more about the culture and traditions of Northeast India. Continue your exploration by visiting the Mawphlang Sacred Forest, a lush green forest of cultural significance to the Khasi tribe. Later, visit Laitlum Canyons, which offers breathtaking views and great photo opportunities. In the evening, enjoy the peaceful atmosphere of Umiam Lake, also known as Barapani, a stunning reservoir just outside Shillong. Return to your hotel for an overnight stay."},"type":"TEXT"}],"type":"PARAGRAPH"},{"paragraphData":{"textStyle":{"textAlignment":"AUTO"}},"style":{},"id":"xxiis5176","nodes":[],"type":"PARAGRAPH"},{"style":{},"id":"sz9lv5034","nodes":[{"id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"decorations":[{"fontWeightValue":700,"type":"BOLD"}],"text":"Day 3: Shillong to Cherrapunji (2hrs/60kms)"},"type":"TEXT"}],"headingData":{"level":6,"textStyle":{"textAlignment":"AUTO"}},"type":"HEADING"},{"paragraphData":{"textStyle":{"textAlignment":"AUTO"}},"style":{},"id":"029my5036","nodes":[{"id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"decorations":[{"colorData":{"background":"transparent","foreground":"rgb(0, 0, 0)"},"type":"COLOR"}],"text":"After breakfast, embark on a drive to Cherrapunji (approximately 2-3 hours). Once you arrive, visit Nohkalikai Falls, one of the tallest waterfalls in India. Afterward, explore Mawsmai Cave, a well-lit limestone cave that is easy to explore. Next, visit the Seven Sisters Waterfalls, a series of stunning waterfalls in the region. In the evening, enjoy the cool, misty atmosphere of this hill station and stay overnight in Cherrapunji at a hotel or homestay."},"type":"TEXT"}],"type":"PARAGRAPH"},{"paragraphData":{"textStyle":{"textAlignment":"AUTO"}},"style":{},"id":"egkp85162","nodes":[],"type":"PARAGRAPH"},{"style":{},"id":"akomd5038","nodes":[{"id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"decorations":[{"fontWeightValue":700,"type":"BOLD"}],"text":"Day 4: Cherrapunji Sightseeing "},"type":"TEXT"}],"headingData":{"level":6,"textStyle":{"textAlignment":"AUTO"}},"type":"HEADING"},{"paragraphData":{"textStyle":{"textAlignment":"AUTO"}},"style":{},"id":"3kuzm5040","nodes":[{"id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"decorations":[{"colorData":{"background":"transparent","foreground":"rgb(0, 0, 0)"},"type":"COLOR"}],"text":"Start your day with a visit to the famous Living Root Bridges in Nongriat Village. A short trek will lead you to the double-decker root bridge, a rewarding sight. Continue  to Dainthlen Waterfall, one of the most picturesque falls in the area, before heading to Thangkharang Park, which offers stunning views of the plains of Bangladesh. In the evening, relax and enjoy the peaceful ambiance of Cherrapunji. Stay overnight in Cherrapunji."},"type":"TEXT"}],"type":"PARAGRAPH"},{"paragraphData":{"textStyle":{"textAlignment":"AUTO"}},"style":{},"id":"9x6a55361","nodes":[],"type":"PARAGRAPH"},{"style":{},"id":"5ysuu5050","nodes":[{"id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"decorations":[{"fontWeightValue":700,"type":"BOLD"}],"text":"Day 5: Cherrapunji to Mawlynnong & Dawki (2hrs/60kms) – Return to Shillong "},"type":"TEXT"}],"headingData":{"level":6,"textStyle":{"textAlignment":"AUTO"}},"type":"HEADING"},{"paragraphData":{"textStyle":{"textAlignment":"AUTO"}},"style":{},"id":"rh69c5052","nodes":[{"id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"decorations":[{"colorData":{"background":"transparent","foreground":"rgb(0, 0, 0)"},"type":"COLOR"}],"text":"After breakfast, drive to Mawlynnong Village (approx. 2 hours), known as the cleanest village in Asia. Walk around the village, enjoying its cleanliness and beautiful surroundings. Visit the Sky View in Mawlynnong, a bamboo structure offering panoramic views of the region, including a view of Bangladesh. Continue your journey to Dawki (about 1-1.5 hours), where you can enjoy a boat ride on the Umngot River, famous for its crystal-clear waters. Afterward, return to Shillong by evening and enjoy an overnight stay there."},"type":"TEXT"}],"type":"PARAGRAPH"},{"id":"wt90b5054","nodes":[],"paragraphData":{"textStyle":{"textAlignment":"AUTO"}},"type":"PARAGRAPH"},{"style":{},"id":"zjr205055","nodes":[{"id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"decorations":[{"fontWeightValue":700,"type":"BOLD"}],"text":"Day 6: Shillong to Kaziranga National Park (5hrs/200kms)"},"type":"TEXT"}],"headingData":{"level":6,"textStyle":{"textAlignment":"AUTO"}},"type":"HEADING"},{"paragraphData":{"textStyle":{"textAlignment":"AUTO"}},"style":{},"id":"k8qir5057","nodes":[{"id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"decorations":[{"colorData":{"background":"transparent","foreground":"rgb(0, 0, 0)"},"type":"COLOR"}],"text":"After breakfast, check out from your Shillong hotel and drive to Kaziranga National Park, which takes approximately 5 hours. Upon arrival, check in to your resort, freshen up, and relax. You may also enjoy an optional safari or simply relax in the serene environment of your resort. In the evening, enjoy leisure time at the resort or explore the surroundings. Stay overnight in Kaziranga."},"type":"TEXT"}],"type":"PARAGRAPH"},{"paragraphData":{"textStyle":{"textAlignment":"AUTO"}},"style":{},"id":"iidj95078","nodes":[],"type":"PARAGRAPH"},{"style":{},"id":"rj1a15059","nodes":[{"id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"decorations":[{"fontWeightValue":700,"type":"BOLD"}],"text":"Day 7: Kaziranga National Park Safari & Departure"},"type":"TEXT"}],"headingData":{"level":6,"textStyle":{"textAlignment":"AUTO"}},"type":"HEADING"},{"paragraphData":{"textStyle":{"textAlignment":"AUTO"}},"style":{},"id":"gvm5w5061","nodes":[{"id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"decorations":[{"colorData":{"background":"transparent","foreground":"rgb(0, 0, 0)"},"type":"COLOR"}],"text":"Start your day with an early morning elephant safari, followed by a jeep safari in the park to spot the famous one-horned rhinoceros, tigers, elephants, and various birds. After the safari, visit the Kaziranga Orchid Park to explore its diverse range of orchids. After breakfast, check out from your hotel and drive back to Guwahati (approx. 5 hours). Upon arrival, transfer to Guwahati Airport or Railway Station for your onward journey."},"type":"TEXT"}],"type":"PARAGRAPH"},{"id":"e2lgt5063","nodes":[],"paragraphData":{"textStyle":{"textAlignment":"AUTO"}},"type":"PARAGRAPH"},{"id":"fkaa75064","nodes":[],"paragraphData":{"textStyle":{"textAlignment":"AUTO"}},"type":"PARAGRAPH"}]}

Day 1: Arrival in Guwahati & Transfer to Shillong (3-4hrs/100kms)

Arrive in Guwahati via flight or train. From there, transfer to Shillong, the capital of Meghalaya, which takes approximately 3-4 hours by road. Upon arrival in Shillong, check in to your hotel, relax, and freshen up. In the evening, explore Police Bazar, a lively market area, and take a peaceful stroll around Ward’s Lake. Enjoy some local delicacies for dinner and stay overnight at the hotel.



Day 2: Shillong Sightseeing 

Start your day with a visit to Shillong Peak, where you can enjoy panoramic views of the city and the surrounding Khasi Hills. Next, explore Elephant Falls, one of the most beautiful waterfalls in Shillong. Afterward, head to the Don Bosco Museum to learn more about the culture and traditions of Northeast India. Continue your exploration by visiting the Mawphlang Sacred Forest, a lush green forest of cultural significance to the Khasi tribe. Later, visit Laitlum Canyons, which offers breathtaking views and great photo opportunities. In the evening, enjoy the peaceful atmosphere of Umiam Lake, also known as Barapani, a stunning reservoir just outside Shillong. Return to your hotel for an overnight stay.



Day 3: Shillong to Cherrapunji (2hrs/60kms)

After breakfast, embark on a drive to Cherrapunji (approximately 2-3 hours). Once you arrive, visit Nohkalikai Falls, one of the tallest waterfalls in India. Afterward, explore Mawsmai Cave, a well-lit limestone cave that is easy to explore. Next, visit the Seven Sisters Waterfalls, a series of stunning waterfalls in the region. In the evening, enjoy the cool, misty atmosphere of this hill station and stay overnight in Cherrapunji at a hotel or homestay.



Day 4: Cherrapunji Sightseeing 

Start your day with a visit to the famous Living Root Bridges in Nongriat Village. A short trek will lead you to the double-decker root bridge, a rewarding sight. Continue  to Dainthlen Waterfall, one of the most picturesque falls in the area, before heading to Thangkharang Park, which offers stunning views of the plains of Bangladesh. In the evening, relax and enjoy the peaceful ambiance of Cherrapunji. Stay overnight in Cherrapunji.



Day 5: Cherrapunji to Mawlynnong & Dawki (2hrs/60kms) – Return to Shillong 

After breakfast, drive to Mawlynnong Village (approx. 2 hours), known as the cleanest village in Asia. Walk around the village, enjoying its cleanliness and beautiful surroundings. Visit the Sky View in Mawlynnong, a bamboo structure offering panoramic views of the region, including a view of Bangladesh. Continue your journey to Dawki (about 1-1.5 hours), where you can enjoy a boat ride on the Umngot River, famous for its crystal-clear waters. Afterward, return to Shillong by evening and enjoy an overnight stay there.



Day 6: Shillong to Kaziranga National Park (5hrs/200kms)

After breakfast, check out from your Shillong hotel and drive to Kaziranga National Park, which takes approximately 5 hours. Upon arrival, check in to your resort, freshen up, and relax. You may also enjoy an optional safari or simply relax in the serene environment of your resort. In the evening, enjoy leisure time at the resort or explore the surroundings. Stay overnight in Kaziranga.



Day 7: Kaziranga National Park Safari & Departure

Start your day with an early morning elephant safari, followed by a jeep safari in the park to spot the famous one-horned rhinoceros, tigers, elephants, and various birds. After the safari, visit the Kaziranga Orchid Park to explore its diverse range of orchids. After breakfast, check out from your hotel and drive back to Guwahati (approx. 5 hours). Upon arrival, transfer to Guwahati Airport or Railway Station for your onward journey.

"},"type":"TEXT"}],"paragraphData":{"indentation":0,"textStyle":{"textAlignment":"AUTO"}},"type":"PARAGRAPH"},{"id":"p58p112225","nodes":[],"paragraphData":{"indentation":0,"textStyle":{"textAlignment":"AUTO"}},"type":"PARAGRAPH"},{"id":"r2j2p12239","nodes":[{"id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"decorations":[],"text":"The Chang La (also known as Changla) is one of the highest mountain roads of the country. This road is usually open all year, but it can be closed anytime when the access is not cleared of snow. The Changla Pass is the main gateway for the Changthang Plateau situated in the Himalayas. The pass is located on the 134 km-long (83 mi) road between the Pangong Lake and Leh. Road closures can be frequent. "},"type":"TEXT"}],"paragraphData":{"indentation":0,"textStyle":{"textAlignment":"AUTO"}},"type":"PARAGRAPH"},{"id":"cpk4d12254","nodes":[],"paragraphData":{"indentation":0,"textStyle":{"textAlignment":"AUTO"}},"type":"PARAGRAPH"},{"id":"iiiii12269","nodes":[{"id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"decorations":[],"text":"Later, we drive down to the village of Tangtse, where you can relax for a cup of tea.
